snippet.title: Alien Hominid PlayStation Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Both Alien Hominid HD and Alien Hominid Invasion will launch on PlayStation4 and PlayStation5 on June 10, 2025!  

Alien Hominid HD - With your mighty blaster and a group of mysterious kids by your side, destroy the agency, find Area 51, and reclaim your spaceship! Navigate your surroundings by jumping, dodging attacks, grabbing agents, and digging underground! Use your trusted blaster to shoot at anything in your path and hurl grenades towards your enemies for epic explosions! Catch agents off guard with your knife in close-up combat, or chomp their heads off if that’s more your style.

Alien Hominid Invasion - Abduct intel from your enemies to sabotage their plans, observe the oddities of human life, blow up bosses, and mutate into a variety of powerful alien forms in order to take down the not-so-secret agents that are dead set on ruining your day. Get a group of up to four players together for the most chaotic invasion possible!

Both games will be available separately or together at a discount in the Extra Terrestrial Bundle on launch!
